cards.text: Philip (not the apostle Philip) is one of seven men the church in Jerusalem chose to serve (Acts 6:3-5), and he's been preaching about the Christ in Samaria (Acts 8:5). Now an angel of the Lord comes to him with orders: get up and go south.

cards.question: The angel of the Lord sends Philip south. Which road does the angel send him to?

answers.text: The desert road from Jerusalem to Gaza
The road down from Jerusalem to Jericho
The highway up from Bethel to Shechem

cards.text: So Philip starts out, and on the way he meets an Ethiopian eunuch, a court official in charge of the ENTIRE treasury of Candace, queen of the Ethiopians. Friend, the last time somebody spent money on ME, it was a quarter out of a closing bakery's bin.

cards.question: The Ethiopian official had traveled all the way to Jerusalem. What for?

cards.text: Now he's headed home, sitting in his chariot, reading Isaiah the prophet. Then the Spirit speaks to Philip.

cards.question: The Spirit tells Philip to stay away from the Ethiopian official's chariot.

cards.text: So Philip RUNS up to that chariot, close enough to hear the man reading Isaiah. Friend, I hop across my bakery on this gold base and I'm out of breath before I reach the ovens.

cards.question: Philip hears the Ethiopian official reading Isaiah. What does Philip ask him?

answers.text: Do you understand what you are reading
Where did you get that scroll
Why are you reading it out here

cards.question: The Ethiopian official tells Philip he understands Isaiah just fine on his own.

cards.text: Then he invites Philip to come up and sit with him. Friend, when a stranger runs up to most people's cars, they LOCK the doors.

Here's what he's reading, from Isaiah 53:7-8: “He was led like a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is silent, so He did not open His mouth.” It goes on to say He was deprived of justice, and His life was removed from the earth.

cards.question: The Ethiopian official has a question about this Scripture from Isaiah. What does he want to know?

answers.text: Whether the prophet means himself or someone else
Whether the prophet wrote it while in Jerusalem
Whether the prophet saw these things in a dream

cards.question: Philip begins with the Isaiah passage the official was reading and tells him the good news about ___.

cards.text: They keep traveling along the road together. And right there on that desert road, they come to some water.

cards.question: Seeing the water by the road, the Ethiopian official asks what is there to prevent him from being baptized.

cards.text: He orders the chariot to stop, and Philip baptizes him right there in the water. When they come up, the Spirit of the Lord carries Philip away, and the official sees him no more.

cards.question: With Philip gone, the newly baptized official goes on his way ___.
Philip turns up at Azotus. What does he do from there?

answers.text: Preaches the gospel in every town to Caesarea
Heads straight back to the apostles in Jerusalem
Rests in Azotus until the angel comes back
